statements.impact_statement: The worker runtime does not ship cmd/go, and no shipped binary links golang.org/x/mod, so the vulnerable sumdb.Client.Lookup implementation is absent. The shipped buildctl, buildkitd, buildkit-runc-gvisor, and railpack binaries report the fixed Go 1.26.6 toolchain. Remove this statement if cmd/go enters the runtime, a shipped binary links golang.org/x/mod below 0.40.0, or the Go builder regresses below 1.26.6.
